US/EU indie teams conflate described-video capability with storefront language. iOS Settings and App Store Connect actually separate them:

  • Audio Descriptions on the device — when enabled under Settings → Accessibility → Hearing → Audio Descriptions, iOS, iPadOS, and tvOS play spoken narration describing visual action during pauses in dialogue on supported movies and TV with described-video tracks. System accessibility behavior — outside AppLocale scope.
  • AVFoundation audio-description tracks & described-video player UI — in-app code that loads AD narration tracks, syncs described audio with video playback, or detects system Audio Descriptions preferences. Engineering inside the binary — not listing rewrite.

An app that ships described-video-aware media playback in the binary and a localized China listing are both valuable — neither replaces the other. AppLocale covers how you describe Audio Descriptions accessibility on the store page, not whether AD narration tracks render inside your video player.

What Apple Audio Descriptions is — and what your listing may claim

Apple ships Audio Descriptions under Settings → Accessibility → Hearing → Audio Descriptions. When enabled, the device plays spoken narration describing visual action during pauses in dialogue on supported movies and TV with described-video tracks. Western indie listings often show one or more of these surfaces on the US product page. AppLocale covers paste-ready zh-Hans copy for whichever your screenshots and description already claim:

  • Audio Descriptions toggle (口述影像 / 音频描述) — master switch that enables described-video narration on supported media. Gallery frames may show the Hearing settings branch or a Works with Audio Descriptions badge.
  • Described-video playback in your app — in-app video players, streaming sessions, or lesson modules that respect system Audio Descriptions when AD tracks are available. Screenshot overlays often show described-video controls or AD track indicators on video frames.
  • Works with Audio Descriptions marketing — when your English listing claims compatibility with Apple's system described-video toggle. zh-Hans copy should use 口述影像 or 音频描述 aligned with iOS Settings — not generic 朗读 (read-aloud) vocabulary.
  • tvOS and cross-device described video — when your English listing shows Apple TV or tvOS Audio Descriptions workflows alongside iPhone playback. zh-Hans copy should name the correct platform per frame.

Your gallery may lead with an Audio Descriptions settings toggle on one frame and an in-app video player with described-video controls on the next. zh-Hans caption lines should name the correct surface per frame — a Hearing settings toggle is not a Magnifier camera narration overlay, and a Closed Captions text bar is not an Audio Descriptions narration track unless that is what the screenshot shows.

Audio Descriptions-specific listing vocabulary — what translates differently

Described-video marketing on App Store pages uses vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese buyers describe Audio Descriptions in iOS Settings — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Official Settings vocabulary

Apple's zh-Hans Settings UI uses 口述影像 for Audio Descriptions under 辅助功能 → 听觉 → 口述影像 (Accessibility → Hearing → Audio Descriptions). Commerce phrasing also includes 音频描述 (audio description), 描述性音频 (descriptive audio), and 描述性视频 (described video) when your gallery shows described-video workflows. Listing copy should mirror that vocabulary — not generic 朗读 (read-aloud) alone when your English source specifically claimed Audio Descriptions.

Audio Descriptions vs Closed Captions

Closed Captions + SDH displays embedded text caption and SDH subtitle tracks on media — 隐藏式字幕, 听障字幕. Audio Descriptions plays spoken narration describing visual action during dialogue pauses — 口述影像, 音频描述. zh-Hans listing copy should not imply 隐藏式字幕 when your English source only shows described-video AD track toggles or narration demos.

Audio Descriptions vs Magnifier Image Descriptions

Image Descriptions covers Magnifier Detection Mode camera scene narration — pointing the camera to hear spoken descriptions of real-world objects — 图像描述. Audio Descriptions covers described-video narration tracks on movies and TV — 口述影像. If your English gallery shows a Magnifier camera overlay, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to movie AD vocabulary unless that is what the frame shows.

Audio Descriptions vs Live Caption

Live Caption generates real-time speech-to-text subtitles for heard audio — 实时字幕. Audio Descriptions plays pre-authored spoken narration of visual action — 口述影像. If your English gallery shows Live Caption speech-to-text overlays, keep zh-Hans copy on 实时字幕 vocabulary, not described-video AD claims.

Audio Descriptions vs VoiceOver and Speak Screen

VoiceOver navigates the UI as a screen reader — 旁白. Speak Screen reads on-screen text aloud — 朗读屏幕. Audio Descriptions plays described-video narration tracks embedded in supported media — 口述影像. If your English gallery shows a VoiceOver rotor or Speak Screen swipe gesture, keep zh-Hans copy on screen-reader or read-aloud vocabulary, not described-video claims.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need described-video search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 口述影像, 音频描述, and 描述性视频 each signal different intent from 隐藏式字幕 or 图像描述 keywords.

Caption lines vs burned-in badges

Marketing screenshot overlays you control — "Audio Descriptions" headlines on gallery frames showing described-video controls — are separate caption fields or burned-in PNG text. See Screenshot captions in Simplified Chinese for caption-field mechanics when overlays are editable in Connect.

AppLocale FAQ

Is Audio Descriptions the same as Closed Captions or SDH?

No. Audio Descriptions plays spoken narration describing visual action on supported movies and TV — 口述影像, 音频描述. Closed Captions + SDH displays embedded text caption and SDH subtitle tracks — 隐藏式字幕, 听障字幕. See our Closed Captions listing guide only if on-screen text captions are your lead marketing claim.

Is Audio Descriptions the same as Magnifier Image Descriptions?

No. Image Descriptions covers Magnifier Detection Mode camera scene narration — 图像描述. Audio Descriptions covers described-video narration tracks on movies and TV — 口述影像. Different features, different Connect string families.

Is Audio Descriptions the same as Live Caption?

No. Live Caption generates real-time speech-to-text subtitles for heard audio — 实时字幕. Audio Descriptions plays pre-authored spoken narration of visual action — 口述影像. See our Live Caption listing guide only if on-device speech subtitles are your lead marketing claim.

Is Audio Descriptions the same as VoiceOver or Speak Screen?

No. VoiceOver navigates the screen as a screen reader — 旁白. Speak Screen reads on-screen text aloud — 朗读屏幕. Audio Descriptions plays described-video narration tracks embedded in supported media — 口述影像. Different Accessibility branches with different screenshot vocabulary.
